# ANKI CARDS - LLM Context (Full)

Site: https://aiankipro.com

## What This Product Is

ANKI CARDS is a web app for learning with flashcards. It combines:

- Markdown-first card authoring
- Deck organization
- Study workflows with review scheduling
- AI-assisted card generation
- Per-card AI tutor chat with saved history and summaries

## Primary User Flows

1. Sign in
2. Create a deck or generate cards from a topic
3. Study cards and rate recall quality
4. Use tutor chat on difficult cards
5. Continue improving content over time
